8	/-!
9	# Functoriality of the locally certified divisor vehicle (DD-2 stage S6a)
10	
11	The locally certified vehicle `divFamZar`
12	(`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyZarVehicle`) is functorial along an
13	*arbitrary* morphism `f : T' ⟶ T` of test objects: the value of the restricted family
14	at an affine open `W ⊆ T'.left` — whose `f`-image need not lie in any affine open of
15	`T.left` — is *glued* over a finite basic-open refinement of `W` subordinate to the
16	preimages of affine opens, using the S5b Zariski keystones of `DivFamZar` through the
17	basic-open toolkit (`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyZarMapKit`).  This is the
18	`picEtMap` pattern (`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.PicEtMap`), clause for clause.
19	
20	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divFamZar.IsPullbackValue`: the characterizing property of the
21	  glued value — on every affine sub-open lying in the preimage of an affine open, it
22	  restricts to the pullback of the family value there.  Values with this property are
23	  unique (`pullbackValue_unique`, from Zariski separation) and exist
24	  (`exists_isPullbackValue`, from Zariski gluing).
25	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divFamZar.map C π n f : divFamZar C π n T → divFamZar C π n T'`
26	  with the functor laws `divFamZar.map_id` and `divFamZar.map_comp`, and the
27	  no-gluing evaluation `divFamZar.mapVal_eq_mapAlgHom` on affine opens lying in a
28	  preimage.
29	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divFamZarAffineEquiv_naturality`: the affine comparison
30	  (`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyZarVehicle`) is natural in the test algebra —
31	  over affine tests, `divFamZar.map` along `Spec` of an algebra map corresponds to the
32	  affine-level `DivFamZar.mapAlgHom` under the comparison equivalences.
33	
34	The `divFunctor` packaging as a `CategoryTheory` functor is deliberately NOT frozen
35	here (`informal/spec-dd-2.md` §6: the exact functor spelling is co-signed with the
36	DD-R lane before freezing); everything up to it is delivered.
37	-/

39	set_option autoImplicit false
40	/- Statements mix the section rings `Γ(T.left, ·)` with the locally certified
41	divisor-functor values over them, which are stated on the product spelling
42	`(C ⊗ overSpec k R).left`; see `AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.RelativeSectionsLinear`. -/

50	open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace
51	
52	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
53	
54	attribute [local instance] Over.sectionsAlgebra Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
55	
56	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
57	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom π] {n : ℕ}

59	namespace divFamZar
60	
61	variable {T T' T'' : Over (Spec (.of k))}
62	
63	/-! ## The characterizing property of the glued value -/
64	
65	variable (C π n) in
66	/-- The characterizing property of the value at `W` of the restriction of `s` along
67	`f`: on every affine sub-open of `W` contained in the preimage of an affine open `V`
68	of the target, it restricts to the pullback of the value of `s` at `V`. -/
69	def IsPullbackValue (f : T' ⟶ T) (s : divFamZar C π n T) (W : T'.left.affineOpens)
70	    (v : DivFamZar C Γ(T'.left, W.1) π n) : Prop :=
71	  ∀ (W₀ : T'.left.affineOpens) (hW₀ : W₀.1 ≤ W.1) (V : T.left.affineOpens)
72	    (hV : W₀.1 ≤ f.left ⁻¹ᵁ V.1),
73	    DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (Over.resAlgHom T' hW₀) v
74	      = DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (Over.appLEAlgHom f V.1 W₀.1 hV) (s.1 V)
75	
76	/-- Values with the pullback property are unique — from the Zariski separation of
77	`DivFamZar` over a basic refinement subordinate to the preimages of affine opens. -/
78	theorem pullbackValue_unique {f : T' ⟶ T} {s : divFamZar C π n T}
79	    {W : T'.left.affineOpens} {v v' : DivFamZar C Γ(T'.left, W.1) π n}
80	    (hv : IsPullbackValue C π n f s W v) (hv' : IsPullbackValue C π n f s W v') :
81	    v = v' := by
82	  classical
83	  obtain ⟨sub, hspan, hsub⟩ := Scheme.exists_basic_subcover W.2
84	    (fun U₀ => ∃ V : T.left.affineOpens, U₀ = f.left ⁻¹ᵁ V.1)
85	    (fun w _ => by
86	      obtain ⟨V, hVaff, hfwV, -⟩ := Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp
87	        T.left.isBasis_affineOpens (show f.left.base w ∈ (⊤ : T.left.Opens) from trivial)
88	      exact ⟨f.left ⁻¹ᵁ V, hfwV, ⟨⟨V, hVaff⟩, rfl⟩⟩)
89	  refine eq_of_basic_eq W sub hspan (fun r hr => ?_)
90	  obtain ⟨U₀, ⟨V, rfl⟩, hle⟩ := hsub r hr
91	  rw [hv ⟨_, W.2.basicOpen r⟩ (T'.left.basicOpen_le r) V hle,
92	    hv' ⟨_, W.2.basicOpen r⟩ (T'.left.basicOpen_le r) V hle]
93	
94	set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
95	-- The instance towers over the section rings of the basic refinement exceed the
96	-- default elaboration budget (as in `PicEtMap.exists_isPullbackValue`).
97	/-- **Existence of the glued value**: the restriction of a compatible family along an
98	arbitrary morphism of test objects has a value at every affine open of the source,
99	glued over a finite basic-open refinement subordinate to the preimages of affine
100	opens — the S5b gluing keystone through `divFamZar.exists_glue_of_basic_compat`. -/
101	theorem exists_isPullbackValue (f : T' ⟶ T) (s : divFamZar C π n T)
102	    (W : T'.left.affineOpens) : ∃ v, IsPullbackValue C π n f s W v := by
103	  classical
104	  -- the basic refinement subordinate to preimages of affine opens
105	  obtain ⟨sub, hspan, hsub⟩ := Scheme.exists_basic_subcover W.2
106	    (fun U₀ => ∃ V : T.left.affineOpens, U₀ = f.left ⁻¹ᵁ V.1)
107	    (fun w _ => by
108	      obtain ⟨V, hVaff, hfwV, -⟩ := Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp
109	        T.left.isBasis_affineOpens (show f.left.base w ∈ (⊤ : T.left.Opens) from trivial)
110	      exact ⟨f.left ⁻¹ᵁ V, hfwV, ⟨⟨V, hVaff⟩, rfl⟩⟩)
111	  have hsub' : ∀ r ∈ sub, ∃ V : T.left.affineOpens,
112	      T'.left.basicOpen r ≤ f.left ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 := fun r hr => by
113	    obtain ⟨U₀, ⟨V, rfl⟩, hle⟩ := hsub r hr
114	    exact ⟨V, hle⟩
115	  choose Vc hVc using hsub'
116	  have hbmul : ∀ r r' : ↥sub,
117	      T'.left.basicOpen ((r : Γ(T'.left, W.1)) * (r' : Γ(T'.left, W.1)))
118	        ≤ T'.left.basicOpen (r : Γ(T'.left, W.1)) := fun r r' => by
119	    rw [Scheme.basicOpen_mul]
120	    exact inf_le_left
121	  have hbmul' : ∀ r r' : ↥sub,
122	      T'.left.basicOpen ((r : Γ(T'.left, W.1)) * (r' : Γ(T'.left, W.1)))
123	        ≤ T'.left.basicOpen (r' : Γ(T'.left, W.1)) := fun r r' => by
124	    rw [Scheme.basicOpen_mul]
125	    exact inf_le_right
126	  -- glue the local pullbacks over the basic refinement
127	  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_glue_of_basic_compat W sub hspan
128	    (fun r : ↥sub => DivFamZar.mapAlgHom
129	      (Over.appLEAlgHom f (Vc r.1 r.2).1 (T'.left.basicOpen r.1) (hVc r.1 r.2))
130	      (s.1 (Vc r.1 r.2)))
131	    hbmul hbmul'
132	    (fun r r' => by
133	      -- the overlap compatibility, from choice independence
134	      rw [← DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_comp, ← DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_comp,
135	        Over.resAlgHom_comp_appLEAlgHom, Over.resAlgHom_comp_appLEAlgHom]
136	      exact mapAlgHom_appLE_eq C π n f s (W₀ := ⟨_, W.2.basicOpen (r.1 * r'.1)⟩) _ _)
137	  -- the glued value has the pullback property
138	  refine ⟨z, fun W₀ hW₀ V hV => ?_⟩
139	  obtain ⟨sub₀, hspan₀, hsub₀⟩ := Scheme.exists_basic_subcover W₀.2
140	    (fun U₀ => ∃ r ∈ sub, U₀ = T'.left.basicOpen r)
141	    (fun w hw => by
142	      have hwW : w ∈ (⨆ r ∈ (↑sub : Set Γ(T'.left, W.1)), T'.left.basicOpen r) := by
143	        rw [iSup_basicOpen_of_span_eq_top _ _ hspan]
144	        exact hW₀ hw
145	      obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp hwW
146	      obtain ⟨hrsub, hwr⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp hr
147	      exact ⟨T'.left.basicOpen r, hwr, ⟨r, hrsub, rfl⟩⟩)
148	  refine eq_of_basic_eq W₀ sub₀ hspan₀ (fun q hq => ?_)
149	  obtain ⟨U₀, ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩, hqle⟩ := hsub₀ q hq
150	  -- the left side restricts through the glued datum
151	  have hzr : DivFamZar.mapAlgHom
152	        (Over.resAlgHom T' (T'.left.basicOpen_le r)) z
153	      = DivFamZar.mapAlgHom
154	          (Over.appLEAlgHom f (Vc r hr).1 (T'.left.basicOpen r) (hVc r hr))
155	          (s.1 (Vc r hr)) := hz ⟨r, hr⟩
156	  have hL : DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (Over.resAlgHom T' (T'.left.basicOpen_le q))
157	      (DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (Over.resAlgHom T' hW₀) z)
158	      = DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (Over.appLEAlgHom f (Vc r hr).1 (T'.left.basicOpen q)
159	          (hqle.trans (hVc r hr))) (s.1 (Vc r hr)) := by
160	    rw [← DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_comp, Over.resAlgHom_comp,
161	      show ((T'.left.basicOpen_le q).trans hW₀ :
162	          T'.left.basicOpen q ≤ W.1)
163	        = (hqle.trans (T'.left.basicOpen_le r)) from rfl,
164	      ← Over.resAlgHom_comp T' hqle (T'.left.basicOpen_le r),
165	      DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_comp, hzr, ← DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_comp,
166	      Over.resAlgHom_comp_appLEAlgHom]
167	  -- the right side restricts directly
168	  rw [hL, ← DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_comp, Over.resAlgHom_comp_appLEAlgHom]
169	  exact mapAlgHom_appLE_eq C π n f s (W₀ := ⟨_, W₀.2.basicOpen q⟩) _ _
170	
171	/-- Existence and uniqueness of the glued value. -/
172	theorem existsUnique_isPullbackValue (f : T' ⟶ T) (s : divFamZar C π n T)
173	    (W : T'.left.affineOpens) : ∃! v, IsPullbackValue C π n f s W v := by
174	  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := exists_isPullbackValue f s W
175	  exact ⟨v, hv, fun v' hv' => pullbackValue_unique hv' hv⟩
176	
177	/-! ## The functoriality -/
178	
179	variable (C π n)
180	
181	/-- The value of the restricted family at an affine open of the source. -/
182	noncomputable def mapVal (f : T' ⟶ T) (s : divFamZar C π n T)
183	    (W : T'.left.affineOpens) : DivFamZar C Γ(T'.left, W.1) π n :=
184	  (existsUnique_isPullbackValue f s W).choose
185	
186	lemma mapVal_spec (f : T' ⟶ T) (s : divFamZar C π n T) (W : T'.left.affineOpens) :
187	    IsPullbackValue C π n f s W (mapVal C π n f s W) :=
188	  (existsUnique_isPullbackValue f s W).choose_spec.1
189	
190	lemma mapVal_eq_of (f : T' ⟶ T) (s : divFamZar C π n T) {W : T'.left.affineOpens}
191	    {v : DivFamZar C Γ(T'.left, W.1) π n} (hv : IsPullbackValue C π n f s W v) :
192	    mapVal C π n f s W = v :=
193	  pullbackValue_unique (mapVal_spec C π n f s W) hv
194	
195	/-- The value of the restricted family on an affine open lying in the preimage of an
196	affine open is the plain pullback — no gluing. -/
197	lemma mapVal_eq_mapAlgHom (f : T' ⟶ T) (s : divFamZar C π n T)
198	    {W : T'.left.affineOpens} {V : T.left.affineOpens} (hV : W.1 ≤ f.left ⁻¹ᵁ V.1) :
199	    mapVal C π n f s W
200	      = DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (Over.appLEAlgHom f V.1 W.1 hV) (s.1 V) := by
201	  have h := mapVal_spec C π n f s W W le_rfl V hV
202	  rwa [Over.resAlgHom_rfl, DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_id] at h
203	
204	/-- **Restriction of the locally certified vehicle along an arbitrary morphism of test
205	objects** (`informal/spec-dd-2.md` §6 on the Addendum-2 carrier; the `picEtMap`
206	pattern): the value at each affine open of the source is the glued pullback value. -/
207	noncomputable def map (f : T' ⟶ T) : divFamZar C π n T → divFamZar C π n T' :=
208	  fun s =>
209	    ⟨fun W => mapVal C π n f s W, by
210	      intro U V h
211	      beta_reduce
212	      refine (mapVal_eq_of C π n f s (W := U) ?_).symm
213	      intro W₀ hW₀ V' hV'
214	      rw [← DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_comp, Over.resAlgHom_comp]
215	      exact mapVal_spec C π n f s V W₀ (hW₀.trans h) V' hV'⟩
216	
217	@[simp]
218	lemma map_val (f : T' ⟶ T) (s : divFamZar C π n T) (W : T'.left.affineOpens) :
219	    (map C π n f s).1 W = mapVal C π n f s W :=
220	  rfl
221	
222	/-- The functor law: restriction along the identity is the identity. -/
223	theorem map_id (s : divFamZar C π n T) : map C π n (𝟙 T) s = s := by
224	  refine ext fun W => ?_
225	  rw [map_val]
226	  refine mapVal_eq_of C π n (𝟙 T) s ?_
227	  intro W₀ hW₀ V hV
228	  have hV' : W₀.1 ≤ V.1 := by
229	    intro p hp
230	    have hmem := hV hp
231	    rw [Over.id_left] at hmem
232	    exact hmem
233	  rw [Over.appLEAlgHom_id T V.1 W₀.1 hV hV', s.compat W₀ W hW₀, s.compat W₀ V hV']
234	
235	/-- The functor law: restriction along a composite is the composite of the
236	restrictions. -/
237	theorem map_comp (f : T' ⟶ T) (g : T'' ⟶ T') (s : divFamZar C π n T) :
238	    map C π n (g ≫ f) s = map C π n g (map C π n f s) := by
239	  classical
240	  refine ext fun W => ?_
241	  rw [map_val, map_val]
242	  refine (mapVal_eq_of C π n (g ≫ f) s ?_)
243	  intro W₀ hW₀ V hV
244	  -- refine by basic opens whose `g`-image lies in an affine open inside `f⁻¹ V`
245	  obtain ⟨sub, hspan, hsub⟩ := Scheme.exists_basic_subcover W₀.2
246	    (fun U₀ => ∃ V'' : T'.left.affineOpens,
247	      V''.1 ≤ f.left ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 ∧ U₀ = g.left ⁻¹ᵁ V''.1)
248	    (fun w hw => by
249	      have hgw : g.left.base w ∈ f.left ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 := by
250	        have := hV hw
251	        rw [Over.comp_left] at this
252	        exact this
253	      obtain ⟨V'', hV''aff, hgwV'', hV''le⟩ := Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp
254	        T'.left.isBasis_affineOpens hgw
255	      exact ⟨g.left ⁻¹ᵁ V'', hgwV'', ⟨⟨V'', hV''aff⟩, hV''le, rfl⟩⟩)
256	  refine eq_of_basic_eq W₀ sub hspan (fun q hq => ?_)
257	  obtain ⟨U₀, ⟨V'', hV''le, rfl⟩, hqle⟩ := hsub q hq
258	  -- the left side, through the two glued values
259	  have hL : DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (Over.resAlgHom T'' (T''.left.basicOpen_le q))
260	      (DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (Over.resAlgHom T'' hW₀)
261	        (mapVal C π n g (map C π n f s) W))
262	      = DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (Over.appLEAlgHom g V''.1 (T''.left.basicOpen q) hqle)
263	          (DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (Over.appLEAlgHom f V.1 V''.1 hV''le) (s.1 V)) := by
264	    rw [← DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_comp, Over.resAlgHom_comp,
265	      mapVal_spec C π n g (map C π n f s) W ⟨_, W₀.2.basicOpen q⟩
266	        ((T''.left.basicOpen_le q).trans hW₀) V'' hqle,
267	      map_val, mapVal_eq_mapAlgHom C π n f s hV''le]
268	  rw [hL, ← DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_comp, ← DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_comp,
269	    Over.appLEAlgHom_comp f g V.1 V''.1 (T''.left.basicOpen q) hV''le hqle
270	      (hqle.trans ((g.left.preimage_mono hV''le).trans
271	        (le_of_eq (by rw [Over.comp_left, Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage])))),
272	    Over.resAlgHom_comp_appLEAlgHom]
273	
274	end divFamZar

276	/-! ## Naturality of the affine comparison -/
277	
278	section AffineNaturality
279	
280	variable {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
281	
282	/-- The affine comparison intertwines the section-ring pullback along `Spec` of an
283	algebra map with the algebra map itself (local copy of the `PicEtMap` helper). -/
284	private lemma overSpecΓTop_appLE_comp (φ : A →ₐ[k] B) :
285	    (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k B).toAlgHom.comp
286	      (Over.appLEAlgHom (Over.overSpecMap φ) (overSpecTopAffine A).1
287	        (overSpecTopAffine B).1 le_top)
288	      = φ.comp (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k A).toAlgHom := by
289	  have key : (Over.overSpecMap φ).left.appLE (overSpecTopAffine A).1
290	        (overSpecTopAffine B).1 le_top ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of B)).hom
291	      = (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)).hom ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom := by
292	    have h₁ : (Over.overSpecMap φ).left.appLE (overSpecTopAffine A).1
293	          (overSpecTopAffine B).1 le_top
294	        = (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom)).appTop :=
295	      Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app _
296	    rw [h₁]
297	    exact Scheme.ΓSpecIso_naturality (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom)
298	  ext x
299	  exact congr($(key).hom x)
300	
301	/-- **Naturality of the affine comparison**: over affine tests, `divFamZar.map` along
302	`Spec` of an algebra map corresponds to the affine-level `DivFamZar.mapAlgHom` under
303	the comparison equivalences — the `picEtAffineEquiv_naturality` mirror, the agreement
304	of the glued general-test restriction with the S5b total base change. -/
305	theorem divFamZarAffineEquiv_naturality (φ : A →ₐ[k] B)
306	    (s : divFamZar C π n (overSpec k A)) :
307	    divFamZarAffineEquiv C π n B (divFamZar.map C π n (Over.overSpecMap φ) s)
308	      = DivFamZar.mapAlgHom φ (divFamZarAffineEquiv C π n A s) := by
309	  rw [divFamZarAffineEquiv_apply, divFamZarAffineEquiv_apply, divFamZar.map_val]
310	  have hval := divFamZar.mapVal_eq_mapAlgHom C π n (Over.overSpecMap φ) s

import Mathlib

/-!
# Zariski descent of representability (`thm:representability_zariski_descent`)

This file proves **Zariski descent of representability** (EGA 0_I 4.5.4;
cf. Stacks 01JJ): a presheaf `F : (Sch/S)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type 1` satisfying the Zariski
sheaf axiom (`Scheme.IsZariskiSheafOver`, stated against open covers of the
total space of each `T : Over S`) that is representable over every member of
an open cover of `S` is representable by an `S`-scheme
(`Scheme.representable_of_openCover`).

The definitions `overRes` / `overResHom` / `overResLE` / `IsZariskiSheafOver`
and the statement of the descent theorem previously lived in
`GrassmannianRepresentability.lean` (where the theorem was a typed `sorry`
leaf); they are moved here so the Grassmannian file can consume the proof.

## Proof architecture

The heavy gluing content (cocycle conditions, `Scheme.GlueData`, the
locally-bijective sheaf comparison) is **not** redone by hand: it is delegated
to mathlib's `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.LocalRepresentability.representableBy`
(Stacks 01JJ), which applies to a `Type 0`-valued Zariski *sheaf* on the
absolute category `Scheme.{0}` equipped with a jointly surjective family of
relatively representable open immersions from representables.  The work done
here is the translation layer:

1. **Size reduction / total functor** (`ZariskiDescent.GluedPoint`,
   `ZariskiDescent.gluedFunctor`): the values of `F` live in `Type 1`, so `F`
   cannot be fed to the mathlib theorem directly.  Instead we encode a point
   of the would-be total space over `T : Scheme` as a `Type 0` datum: a base
   morphism `a : T ⟶ S` together with a family of *classifying morphisms*
   `γ i : T|_{a⁻¹ U i} ⟶ Y i` into the local representing objects, compatible
   on overlaps as classified `F`-sections.  The bespoke sheaf axiom for `F`
   shows `GluedPoint T ≃ Σ (a : T ⟶ S), F(T, a)` (`ZariskiDescent.totalEquiv`),
   identifying `gluedFunctor` with the (large) total functor of `F`.
2. **Sheaf axiom** (`ZariskiDescent.isSheaf`): `gluedFunctor` is a sheaf for
   the big Zariski topology.  Covers by arbitrary jointly surjective open
   immersions are reduced to covers by opens of the target (the generated
   sieves agree), where the claim follows from the sheaf axiom of `F` through
   `totalEquiv`.
3. **Charts** (`ZariskiDescent.chart`): each `Y i` maps to `gluedFunctor` by
   sending `t : T ⟶ (Y i).left` to the point classified by the `F`-section
   that `t` represents; these are relatively representable open immersions
   (the pullback against a point `(a, x)` of `gluedFunctor` is the open
   subscheme `a⁻¹ U i ⊆ T`) and jointly surjective.
4. **Conclusion**: mathlib glues a scheme `Ŷ` with `gluedFunctor ≅ Hom(-, Ŷ)`;
   the tautological point of `Ŷ` gives the structure morphism `â : Ŷ ⟶ S`,
   and `totalEquiv` converts the absolute representability into
   `F.RepresentableBy (Over.mk â)`.

## References

Blueprint: `thm:representability_zariski_descent`, `def:zariski_sheaf_over`
(`blueprint/src/chapters/Picard_QuotScheme.tex`).
Source: EGA 0_I 4.5.4; Stacks 01JJ; [Nitsure] §1 (FGA Explained Ch. 5).
-/

/-- The restriction of `T : Over S` to an open `W ⊆ T.left`, as an object of
`Over S`. -/
noncomputable def overRes {S : Scheme.{0}} (T : Over S) (W : T.left.Opens) :

/-- The restriction morphism `T|_W ⟶ T` in `Over S`. -/
noncomputable def overResHom {S : Scheme.{0}} (T : Over S) (W : T.left.Opens) :

  Over.homMk W.ι rfl

/-- The inclusion `T|_{W'} ⟶ T|_W` in `Over S` attached to `W' ≤ W`. -/
noncomputable def overResLE {S : Scheme.{0}} (T : Over S)
    {W' W : T.left.Opens} (h : W' ≤ W) : overRes T W' ⟶ overRes T W :=

/-- **The Zariski sheaf axiom for a presheaf on `Sch/S`**: for every
`T : Over S` and every open cover `{W k}` of the total space `T.left`, a
family of sections of `F` over the restrictions `T|_{W k}` that agree on the

condition for the (big) Zariski site of `S`, stated concretely against open
covers of the total space; representable presheaves satisfy it, and it is the
hypothesis under which local representability descends
(`Scheme.representable_of_openCover`). -/
def IsZariskiSheafOver {S : Scheme.{0}} (F : (Over S)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type 1) : Prop :=

    ∃! x₀ : F.obj (Opposite.op T), ∀ k, F.map (overResHom T (W k)).op x₀ = x k

/-!
# Zariski descent of representability (`thm:representability_zariski_descent`)

This file proves **Zariski descent of representability** (EGA 0_I 4.5.4;
cf. Stacks 01JJ): a presheaf `F : (Sch/S)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type 1` satisfying the Zariski
sheaf axiom (`Scheme.IsZariskiSheafOver`, stated against open covers of the
total space of each `T : Over S`) that is representable over every member of
an open cover of `S` is representable by an `S`-scheme
(`Scheme.representable_of_openCover`).

The definitions `overRes` / `overResHom` / `overResLE` / `IsZariskiSheafOver`
and the statement of the descent theorem previously lived in
`GrassmannianRepresentability.lean` (where the theorem was a typed `sorry`
leaf); they are moved here so the Grassmannian file can consume the proof.

## Proof architecture

The heavy gluing content (cocycle conditions, `Scheme.GlueData`, the
locally-bijective sheaf comparison) is **not** redone by hand: it is delegated
to mathlib's `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.LocalRepresentability.representableBy`
(Stacks 01JJ), which applies to a `Type 0`-valued Zariski *sheaf* on the
absolute category `Scheme.{0}` equipped with a jointly surjective family of
relatively representable open immersions from representables.  The work done
here is the translation layer:

1. **Size reduction / total functor** (`ZariskiDescent.GluedPoint`,
   `ZariskiDescent.gluedFunctor`): the values of `F` live in `Type 1`, so `F`
   cannot be fed to the mathlib theorem directly.  Instead we encode a point
   of the would-be total space over `T : Scheme` as a `Type 0` datum: a base
   morphism `a : T ⟶ S` together with a family of *classifying morphisms*
   `γ i : T|_{a⁻¹ U i} ⟶ Y i` into the local representing objects, compatible
   on overlaps as classified `F`-sections.  The bespoke sheaf axiom for `F`
   shows `GluedPoint T ≃ Σ (a : T ⟶ S), F(T, a)` (`ZariskiDescent.totalEquiv`),
   identifying `gluedFunctor` with the (large) total functor of `F`.
2. **Sheaf axiom** (`ZariskiDescent.isSheaf`): `gluedFunctor` is a sheaf for
   the big Zariski topology.  Covers by arbitrary jointly surjective open
   immersions are reduced to covers by opens of the target (the generated
   sieves agree), where the claim follows from the sheaf axiom of `F` through
   `totalEquiv`.
3. **Charts** (`ZariskiDescent.chart`): each `Y i` maps to `gluedFunctor` by
   sending `t : T ⟶ (Y i).left` to the point classified by the `F`-section
   that `t` represents; these are relatively representable open immersions
   (the pullback against a point `(a, x)` of `gluedFunctor` is the open
   subscheme `a⁻¹ U i ⊆ T`) and jointly surjective.
4. **Conclusion**: mathlib glues a scheme `Ŷ` with `gluedFunctor ≅ Hom(-, Ŷ)`;
   the tautological point of `Ŷ` gives the structure morphism `â : Ŷ ⟶ S`,
   and `totalEquiv` converts the absolute representability into
   `F.RepresentableBy (Over.mk â)`.

(`blueprint/src/chapters/Picard_QuotScheme.tex`).

/-- The restriction of `T : Over S` to an open `W ⊆ T.left`, as an object of
`Over S`. -/
noncomputable def overRes {S : Scheme.{0}} (T : Over S) (W : T.left.Opens) :
    Over S :=
  Over.mk (W.ι ≫ T.hom)

/-- The restriction morphism `T|_W ⟶ T` in `Over S`. -/
noncomputable def overResHom {S : Scheme.{0}} (T : Over S) (W : T.left.Opens) :
    overRes T W ⟶ T :=
  Over.homMk W.ι rfl

/-- The inclusion `T|_{W'} ⟶ T|_W` in `Over S` attached to `W' ≤ W`. -/
noncomputable def overResLE {S : Scheme.{0}} (T : Over S)
    {W' W : T.left.Opens} (h : W' ≤ W) : overRes T W' ⟶ overRes T W :=
  Over.homMk (T.left.homOfLE h)
    ((Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans
      (congrArg (· ≫ T.hom) (T.left.homOfLE_ι h)))

/-- **The Zariski sheaf axiom for a presheaf on `Sch/S`**: for every
`T : Over S` and every open cover `{W k}` of the total space `T.left`, a
family of sections of `F` over the restrictions `T|_{W k}` that agree on the
pairwise intersections glues to a unique section over `T`.  This is the sheaf
condition for the (big) Zariski site of `S`, stated concretely against open
covers of the total space; representable presheaves satisfy it, and it is the
hypothesis under which local representability descends
(`Scheme.representable_of_openCover`). -/
def IsZariskiSheafOver {S : Scheme.{0}} (F : (Over S)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type 1) : Prop :=
  ∀ (T : Over S) {κ : Type} (W : κ → T.left.Opens), (⨆ k, W k = ⊤) →
    ∀ x : ∀ k, F.obj (Opposite.op (overRes T (W k))),
    (∀ k l : κ, F.map (overResLE T (inf_le_left : W k ⊓ W l ≤ W k)).op (x k)
      = F.map (overResLE T (inf_le_right : W k ⊓ W l ≤ W l)).op (x l)) →
    ∃! x₀ : F.obj (Opposite.op T), ∀ k, F.map (overResHom T (W k)).op x₀ = x k

datum `(divFunctor C π g).RepresentableBy DivOver`.  It deliberately does **not**

half of the lift.

The mechanism is the affine-open test objects `Over.fromSpecAffine T W`
(`Picard/PicEtUnit.lean`): every affine open `W ⊆ T.left` presents the affine test
`overSpec k Γ(T.left, W)` over `T`, coherently under restriction
(`Over.fromSpecAffine_resAlgHom`) and along arbitrary test morphisms
(`Over.fromSpecAffine_naturality`).  Since the vehicle `divFamZar C π g T` is by
definition the family of its values on affine opens, the affine forward maps assemble
with **no gluing at all**:

* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivRepAffinePullback.pullGlobal` — the general-test pullback,
